businesses.business: Specialty chemicals and industrial data analytics

offering_description.value: Flotek provides specialty chemicals and data analytics to oil and gas businesses. Its specialists assess customer reservoirs and use the findings to formulate chemicals that improve well performance and recovery.

quotes.quote: Discover Flotek's innovative chemistry solutions and data analytics, designed to enhance the performance and economics of your oil and gas operations.

Flotek collaborates closely with our customers to thoroughly assess the intricate geological characteristics of their reservoirs. This comprehensive evaluation is founded on extensive mapping, reservoir sampling, completion strategy analysis, predictions of decline curves, as well as considerations of wellbore depth and trajectory, alongside downhole temperature data. Our dedication to identifying and meticulously analyzing this dataset in partnership with our customers allows us to formulate our chemistry with pinpoint precision, which is designed to improve well performance and enhance recovery rates.

primary_products.value: Well stimulation fluids and additives; friction reducers; specialty polymers and surfactants for drilling fluids

quotes.quote: At the heart of this offering stands our pioneering Complex Nano-Fluid® stimulation technologies, which have a demonstrated ability to expedite the extraction of oil and gas from the reservoir more efficiently than conventional methods. Complementing this core technology, is our comprehensive suite of total fluid solutions, which includes traditional friction reducers and conventional stimulation additives. Together, these innovations empower us to provide a holistic approach to optimize oil and gas production.

Flotek is a leading innovator in the realm of specialty polymers and surfactants, dedicated to engineering compounds that excel in overcoming the formidable challenges encountered in diverse industries. Our extensive range of high-performance additives is carefully crafted to elevate key functions, including rheology, suspension, fluids loss control, hole cleaning and other critical aspects in both water- and oil-based drilling fluids.

primary_services.value: Chemistry logistics; real-time data measurement and performance optimization

quotes.quote: Our comprehensive chemistry technologies, logistics and services are designed to help our customers improve their return on capital, lower their operational costs and realize tangible environmental benefits, no matter the complexity or location.
Providing optimization of efficiency and output through real-time data measurements.

customer_segment.value: B2B: Oil and gas operators and oilfield service companies

quotes.quote: Empowering operators to boost production, while minimizing costs per barrel
Partnering with service companies to leverage our capabilities and resources, optimizing their operations.

quotes.quote: Providing efficient and effective measurement and support for upstream, midstream and downstream applications.
Harnessing laser technology, patented gas distribution and intelligent software to transform mobile power generation.

revenue_model.value: product sales: Standard chemical products and custom finished blends; service fees: Delivery of operational data as a service

quotes.quote: Whether your needs encompass standard base products or bespoke finished blends, our expertise is ready to effectively fulfill your business requirements. Flotek Chemistry’s IOR (Improved Oil Recovery) chemicals are designed to optimize recovery while upholding environmental responsibility. Our innovative CnF® suite and other advanced technologies are geared towards maximizing efficiency and sustainability in the oil and gas sector.

Flotek stands at the forefront of innovation in the realm of the “Data as a Service” model within the oil and gas industry. Our technology boasts an established history of delivering reliable performance and value across global operations, and we continue to further refine our solutions to meet our customer’s changing needs.

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Formulates and manufactures customized fluid systems for oil and gas customers; service provider: Analyzes customer operating data and reservoir findings to design fluid systems for oil and gas customers

quotes.quote: Upon the successful completion of a comprehensive geologic reservoir analysis, Flotek’s Global Research and Innovation Team, comprised of dedicated scientists and engineers, embarks on a series of rigorous tests and experiments. Their goal is to seamlessly integrate the oil and gas data contributed by our customer and information form public data sources with the insights garnered from the geologic reservoir analysis. This fusion of knowledge leads to the formulation of a customized total fluids solution for the customer.

Flotek’s global presence is strategically reinforced by our production facilities placed strategically worldwide, supported by an expansive distribution network, positioning us at the forefront of our industry.
